quote: 1. **Missing quartic portal `χ²φ²` and `χ²s²` (substantive).** The paper's eq. (2.2) contains `λ_ΦS Φ†Φ|S|²` and `(λ_S/2)|S|⁴` in full. Expanding them gives contact vertices `χχhh`, `χχhH` and `χχHH` with coefficients fixed by the same `λ_ΦS` and `λ_S`. The reconstruction keeps only the trilinear part of the same two operators and says in §1.6 that no quartic portal is present. (See also disagreement 2, the paired `−(λ_S/8)χ⁴` term, and the three 'missing-in-reconstruction' table rows for `χ²φ²`, `χ²s²`, and `χ⁴`.)
other_list:
Missing scalar self-interactions of h and H (no hhh, hhH, hHH, HHH vertices; needed for h to HH and for chi chi to hh, hH, HH).
Missing cos(theta)/sin(theta) rescaling of scalar couplings to SM fermions and gauge bosons (H2 ends up with no tree-level coupling to SM matter at all).
lambda_Phi not re-fixed to the eq. (2.18) value (reconstruction keeps the SM value, which differs by a large factor at theta = 1.53).
note: Yes, disagreements 1 and 2 (plus the matching table rows for the chi-chi-hh/hH/HH and chi^4 terms) isolate exactly the missing quartic-portal content that LPortal4 was supposed to supply, so a physicist would be pointed straight at the right term and the right kind of error.
